# the company has arrived and the floor table has rolled; the report is on its way up
DA_HX_roll_pending = {
	has_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below }
}

DA_HX_charter_pathfinders = {
	NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
	NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors }
	NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers }
}

DA_HX_slow_charter = {
	OR = {
		has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
		has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
	}
}

DA_HX_dear_charter = {
	OR = {
		has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	}
}

DA_HX_hold_broken = {
	hold_condition = { Damaged = yes }
}

# a deep is charted but the hold is not yet dug down to it
DA_HX_can_dig_further = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_2 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_2_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_3 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_3_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_4 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_4_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_5 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_5_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_6 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_6_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_7 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_7_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_8 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_8_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_9 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_9_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_10 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_10_or_higher = yes } }
		AND = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_11 NOT = { DA_has_dig_level_11_or_higher = yes } }
	}
}

# what the Send button checks (its tooltips come from here); owner is the country that looks at the window
DA_HX_send_allowed = {
	has_subterranean_race = yes
	is_state_core = owner
	controlled_by = owner
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_modifier = incomplete_hold }
		NOT = { has_province_modifier = incomplete_hold }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_modifier = F23_flooded_depths }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = F23_cannot_dig_why
			always = no
		}
	}
	hidden_trigger = { NOT = { has_province_modifier = incomplete_hold_0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { hold_condition = { Damaged = yes } }
		hold_condition = { Repaired = yes }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = DA_HX_menu_closed_tt
		owner = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_ADK_menu_in_use } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_2 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 40 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 25 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_3 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 75 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 50 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_4 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 150 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 100 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_5 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 300 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 200 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_6 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 450 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 300 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_7 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 750 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 500 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_8 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 1200 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 800 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_9 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 1800 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 1200 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_10 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 3750 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 2500 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_11 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { treasury = 7500 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { treasury = 5000 }
		}
	}
}

# a company could leave from this hold now: the explore marker of the top bar (build_attention_markers.py)
DA_HX_can_send = {
	DA_HX_has_target = yes
	NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress }
	DA_HX_send_allowed = yes
}
